messages:
elaine: Heads-up — noticed a telemetry mismatch in console when a route saved-view triggers a fallback to a cheaper model. Console shows duplicate lines for the same request, seems like the view aggregates by route_id only. Anyone else?
micah: Yep saw it on staging this morning. Looks like the telemetry key we use for the route view omits `served_model_variant` and `fallback_reason`, so fallback requests clobber the original trace and sometimes duplicate counts.
raja: Repro: route A -> model-x normally, but if capacity hits we fallback to model-x-quant. The savedview query groups by `route_id` and `savedview_id` only, then merges logs.
productops: UX question — do we want saved views to surface fallback rows separately or hide them with a small badge? From a customer POV seeing duplicated tokens/latency is confusing.
micah: I'd prefer surface, with a tiny inline tag like `fallback: model-x-quant` so users can filter. Implementation is telemetry change + console rendering. Should be cheap.
elaine: Agree. Two constraints: 1) Do NOT change billing/counting semantics (quota must count the actual served model). 2) Avoid a breaking API change for integrators.
raja: We can add keys optionaly: `served_model_variant` and `fallback_reason`. Null-safe. Console grouping becomes (route_id, savedview_id, served_model_variant?).
micah: Patch idea — telemetry payload adds those optional fields. Console will read them and show a per-row `served_model` column when present. Query grouping defaults to old behavior unless user toggles "group by served model" in savedview UI.
productops: Nice — toggle sounds good for rollout. We should also add a small explanatory tooltip: "Grouped by actual served model to avoid conflated latency/quality metrics when routing fallbacks occur"
deploy-bot: CI /integration-tests for `telemetry-patch` failed on `console-views::grouping` (flaky test). logs: ```FAIL tests/console_view_group_test.py::test_group_by_route_and_model - AssertionError: expected 3 got 4```
micah: Noted. Test is probably asserting exact de-dupe. I'll update tests to accept null `served_model_variant` and to validate grouping toggle.
elaine: Timeline? Can we canary this on ~10% of routes? Also need a migration note for customers about new optional keys.
raja: We'll implement feature-flag rollout. Backend: add optional fields (no change to required fields). Console: add toggle + small column and badge for fallback. Telemetry ingest will index `served_model_variant` for queries (low-cardinality index only).
productops: OK — schedule canary for Tue afternoon, notify customers list, and add console tooltip copy. I'll own release note.
elaine: Thanks. micah/raja pair on patch. micah — ping me once CI green. :thumbsup:
micah: Will do. Patch: `feat(telemetry): optional served_model_variant + fallback_reason` — will open PR after fixing the flaky test.
raja: Quick note — watch quota counting in Dedicated mode, don't route billing through console aggregation. We'll add unit tests for billing invariants.
productops: great. leaving this thread as the single source for rollout plan and copy.
elaine: perfect, thanks everyone.
